question.html:
A sample of air in a sealed container has a pressure of 1.8 × 105 Pa and a density of 2.0 kg m−3.

a Calculate the average translational speed of air molecules. [2]

b The air is a mixture of nitrogen, oxygen and other gases. Explain why the component gases of air in the container have different average translational speeds. [3]

c The temperature of the sample is increased without a change in pressure. Outline the effect it has on the density of the gas. [2]
